title: A limit-preserving base with locally presentable fibres is representable

standard_prerequisites.name: Affines are limits of finite presentation
standard_prerequisites.use: Writes V = lim V_i in Case I.

standard_prerequisites.name: Stackiness of fibre products
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives Zariski stackiness of the fibre product in Case II.

standard_prerequisites.name: Glueing sheaves and spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: Reassembles Z from its local pieces.

core_obligations: Case I: descend y to some V_i and represent the fibre product by Z_i x_{V_i} V.
Case II: show the fibre product is a stack in setoids for the Zariski topology by proving the Isom sheaf is trivial locally, then glue the local algebraic spaces Z_i into an algebraic space Z.
Handle the set-theoretic size condition of the glueing lemma (footnote, details omitted in source).
proof_roadmap: Run the two cases: Case I is a direct limit descent; Case II proves stack-in-setoids by triviality of the Isom sheaf and then glues the local Z_i, with the size bookkeeping in the footnote flagged for the reviewer.
difficulty_reason: Two cases with genuinely different arguments (limit descent vs stack-in-setoids + glueing), plus set-theoretic size verification.
